items.name: DataPageValues
items.summary: The encoded values for a data page, with optional statistics

items.name: DictionaryPage
items.summary: The encoded data for a dictionary page

items.name: ColumnValueEncoder
items.summary: A generic encoder of [`ColumnValues`] to data and dictionary pages used by [super::GenericColumnWriter`]

methods.name: compresses_against_previous_value
methods.summary: Returns true if the encoder compresses each value against the value immediately before it, within the current page.

methods.name: count_values_within_byte_budget
methods.signature: fn count_values_within_byte_budget(_values: &Self::Values, _offset: usize, _len: usize, _byte_budget: usize) -> Option<usize>
methods.summary: Returns the largest `k` such that the first `k` values in `values[offset..offset + len]` encode to at most `byte_budget` bytes — i.e. how many values fit in a single page byte budget.

methods.name: count_values_within_byte_budget_gather
methods.summary: As [`Self::count_values_within_byte_budget`] but using gather `indices` rather than a contiguous range. Returns the number of `indices` that fit, not the maximum index value.

methods.name: estimated_data_page_size
methods.summary: Returns an estimate of the encoded data page size in bytes

methods.name: estimated_dict_page_size
methods.summary: Returns an estimate of the encoded size of dictionary page size in bytes, or `None` if no dictionary

methods.name: estimated_memory_size
methods.summary: Returns the estimated total memory usage of the encoder

methods.name: flush_bloom_filter
methods.summary: Flushes bloom filter if enabled and returns it, otherwise returns `None`. Subsequent writes will *not* be tracked by the bloom filter as it is empty since. This should be called once near the end of encoding.

methods.name: flush_data_page
methods.summary: Flush the next data page for this column chunk

methods.name: flush_dict_page
methods.summary: Flush the dictionary page for this column chunk if any. Any subsequent calls to [`Self::write`] will not be dictionary encoded

methods.name: flush_geospatial_statistics
methods.summary: Computes [`GeospatialStatistics`], if any, and resets internal state such that any internal accumulator is prepared to accumulate statistics for the next column chunk.

methods.name: has_dictionary
methods.summary: Returns true if this encoder has a dictionary page

methods.name: num_values
methods.summary: Returns the number of buffered values

methods.name: try_new
methods.signature: fn try_new(descr: &ColumnDescPtr, props: &WriterProperties) -> Result<Self> where Self: Sized

methods.name: write
methods.signature: fn write(&mut self, values: &Self::Values, offset: usize, len: usize) -> Result<()>
methods.summary: Write the corresponding values to this [`ColumnValueEncoder`]

methods.name: write_gather
methods.signature: fn write_gather(&mut self, values: &Self::Values, indices: &[usize]) -> Result<()>
methods.summary: Write the values at the indexes in `indices` to this [`ColumnValueEncoder`]

items.name: ColumnValues
items.summary: A collection of [`ParquetValueType`] encoded by a [`ColumnValueEncoder`]

methods.name: len
methods.summary: The number of values in this collection
